description: Access and manage your case using your claim number and access code. These will be in the letter, email or pack sent by the court.

errors.respondToClaimUnavailable: The option to respond to a claim is not available at the moment.
errors.claimNumberInvalidCharacters: Claim number must only include numbers 0 to 9 and special characters such as hyphens
errors.claimNumberLength: Claim number must be between 16 and 20 characters
errors.accessCodeInvalidCharacters: Access code must only include letters a to z, and numbers 0 to 9
errors.claimNotFound: We cannot find that claim number. Enter the claim number that you received from the court
errors.accessCodeExpired: The access code you entered has expired. Contact the court to get a new code
errors.accessCodeAlreadyUsed: The access code you entered has already been used, you should contact the court
errors.accessCodeMismatch: Access code does not match claim number
